Reference / http/handler

http/handler#

Handlers: what answers a request.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

object Hello does Handling {
    Hello();

    async handling(request is Request, context is HttpRequestContext) is HandlingResult {
        ResponseHandling(Response(status: Status.ok, content: TextBody(text: "hello")));
    }
}

Description#

Handlers: what answers a request.

A handler answers with a response, or with a WebSocket upgrade and the application that takes the connection. Routes, StaticFiles and the web/ handlers are handlers too.
